title: The Correct answer to the sum
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：correct　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 correct 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the gardener wrote of ① a correct answer to the sum in the notebook, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② more correct than the one named there the year before. Three springs on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the gardener, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the correct ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most correct answer to the sum anybody in the garden had ever seen, or so the notebook for April 1974 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too correct to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the correct ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a correct form for the office, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as correct as the form for the office they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was correct or not, and he said so.

By 1987 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something correct, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite correct; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the correct ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1990, for the whole place, she wrote of another correct answer to the sum in the same notebook, and the work, which took two springs, seemed ⑨ more correct than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most correct form for the office in the whole garden, she said in 1992, was the one she could never quite name; the correct ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 正确（前置定语 a correct answer to the sum：1980 年园丁在园艺笔记里记下的那件正确的答案）
B. adj. 正确／恰当（比较级 more correct than：文中两处，一处比算术的答案，一处比预想）
C. adj. 正确／恰当（最高级 the most correct：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 正确（表语 too correct to do：母亲觉得它太正确，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 恰当（前置定语 a correct form for the office：叔叔把整件事称作一桩恰当的表格）
F. adj. 恰当（同级比较 as correct as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩办公室用的表格相比）
G. adj. 恰当（后置定语 something correct：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 恰当（受程度副词修饰 quite correct：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: a correct answer to the sum
the most correct answer to the sum anybody
a correct form for the office
The most correct form for the office in

answers.why: correct 意为“正确”，1980 年园丁在园艺笔记里记下的是“一件正确的答案”，此处作前置定语 a correct answer to the sum。
correct 意为“正确”，此处用比较级 more correct than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
correct 意为“正确”，园艺笔记上 四月 那行字说它是园子里最正确的一件，故用最高级 the most correct answer to the sum。
correct 意为“正确”，母亲认为这件东西“太正确了，谁也用不上”，too correct to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
correct 意为“恰当”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩恰当的表格”，此处作前置定语 a correct form for the office。
correct 意为“恰当”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩办公室用的表格一样恰当”，同级比较用 as correct as。
correct 意为“恰当”，园艺笔记上那半行字要的是“恰当的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something correct。
correct 意为“恰当”，邻园子来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当恰当”，quite 修饰原级 correct。
correct 意为“恰当”，1990 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要恰当”，故用比较级 more correct than。
correct 意为“恰当”，母亲 1992 年说的是“整个园子里最恰当的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most correct form for the office。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年，园丁在园艺笔记里记下了一件正确的答案。（a correct answer to the sum）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更正确。（more correct than …）
母亲觉得它太正确，谁也用不上。（too correct to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩恰当的表格。（a correct form for the office）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩办公室用的表格一样恰当。（as correct as …）
到了 1987 年，园艺笔记上只剩半行字：要的是一件恰当的东西。（something correct）
answers: In 1980 the gardener wrote of a correct answer to the sum in the notebook.
Everybody said it was more correct than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too correct to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a correct form for the office.
He said nobody would call it as correct as the form for the office they had once had.
By 1987 the notebook asked for nothing but something correct.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 correct 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the gardener wrote of a correct answer to the sum in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most correct answer to the sum in the garden, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too correct to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a correct form for the office, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next garden called the plan quite correct, and everybody laughed.
The correct ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
